about: Every combination of a device's protection facts and the state deviceProtectionOf must return. Generated from the rules in tests/integration/guard-contract/device-protection-vectors.test.ts: run that file with WRITE_PROTECTION_VECTORS=1 after a rule changes. Each implementation of the protection state (the registry for the console, the agent for the Mac) is tested against this file.

rules.pins: d296323 (VIB-54): a revoked Mac reads Revoked, whatever else it reported
913ae9e, 4f1cc88 (VIB-51): an active Mac that reports interception off reads Not protected with that reason, quiet, late or unsynced, in any mode
a60f4a4 (VIB-52): an active Mac silent past Late or Quiet reads Late or Quiet, never Protected or Monitoring
0939b91 (VIB-50): a Mac that has not applied its policy reads No policy yet or Sync failing, never Protected or Monitoring
783705a: a synced Mac in Monitor or Off reads Monitoring or Off
VIB-110: a synced Mac in Enforce reads Protected only with interception on and the extension active
VIB-110: a synced Mac in Enforce without that proof reads Not protected, naming the missing proof
